+def _get_fill_value(var, fill_value):
+    """Get the fill value for a variable, handling special cases."""
+    if fill_value is dtypes.NA:
+        # Use NaN for float types, None for object types
+        if np.issubdtype(var.dtype, np.floating):
+            return np.nan
+        else:
+            return None
+    return fill_value
+
+
+def _create_dummy_variable(var, fill_value):
+    """Create a dummy variable filled with fill_value."""
+    # Get the fill value
+    if fill_value is dtypes.NA:
+        if np.issubdtype(var.dtype, np.floating):
+            fill_val = np.nan
+        else:
+            fill_val = None
+    else:
+        fill_val = fill_value
+    
+    # Create data filled with fill_value
+    data = np.full(var.shape, fill_val, dtype=var.dtype)
+    
+    # Create a new variable with the same dimensions and attributes
+    return Variable(var.dims, data, attrs=var.attrs, encoding=var.encoding)
+
